memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Type 2 diabetes
  - Status: newly diagnosed, asymptomatic, random glucose 182 mg/dL
  - Plan: start metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD; lifestyle modification; weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, above); diet: breakfast – low‑glycemic roti with egg white, lunch – dal‑rice with veg, dinner – light soup & salad; exercise 30 min walk daily
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: intermittent sneezing, nasal congestion, worse in mornings
  - Plan: cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS; avoid dust, use mask at work
- Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-07-05)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Allergic rhinitis – seasonal and perennial; reaction: sneezing, nasal itching, clear rhinorrhea; confirmed by skin prick test.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel tired after work, my nose is blocked most mornings, and I have noticed increased thirst and frequent urination over the past month.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Type 2 diabetes
  - Status: adherent to meds, occasional post‑prandial spikes; HbA1c 7.2%
  - Plan: increase metformin to 500 mg TID after meals; continue other agents; weight 67.5 kg, waist 83 cm (still >80); diet: breakfast – multigrain toast with avocado, lunch – vegetable khichdi, dinner – grilled fish & steamed veg; exercise 45 min brisk walk
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: improved with nasal spray, occasional breakthrough sneezing
  - Plan: continue cetirizine HS, fluticasone OD, montelukast HS; consider intranasal antihistamine if needed
- Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-10-10)

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Type 2 diabetes
  - Status: stable, HbA1c 6.9%; no hypoglycemia
  - Plan: continue current regimen; weight 66.8 kg, waist 82 cm (still >80); diet: breakfast – oats with milk & nuts, lunch – brown rice sambar, dinner – paneer bhurji & salad; add resistance band exercises twice weekly
- Allergic rhinitis

  - Plan: continue current allergic regimen; consider stopping montelukast if symptom‑free for 1 month

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: mild non‑proliferative diabetic retinopathy, microaneurysms temporal to macula, no macular edema. Recommend annual repeat.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Dr. S. Rao, Ophthalmology, Narayana Nethralaya, for baseline retinal evaluation and guidance on retinopathy follow‑up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ophthalmology report: mild NPDR, good glycemic control advised; repeat fundus photo in 12 months. No laser needed at present.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

  - Plan: stop montelukast; continue cetirizine HS and fluticasone OD; monitor for recurrence
- Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2026-04-15)
